author: GameSpot
description:
Resident Evil Requiem looks to combine a bunch of different story threads across both mainline and spinoff titles in the series. For those that are jumping into the franchise for the first time, or for those that need a refresher on key plot details, here’s the story you need to know before playing RE9.
